candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Open to trout fishing all year — Donner Lake is not on CCR §7.50(b)'s special-regulations list, so the statewide default for lakes and reservoirs applies (no closed season).

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 trout per day, 10 in possession — the statewide default limit for California lakes and reservoirs (rainbow, brown, golden, and cutthroat trout combined).

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 kokanee salmon per day, 10 in possession — Donner Lake is not among the reduced-limit exception waters (Bucks, Pardee, New Bullards Bar, Trinity), so the statewide landlocked-salmon default applies. Counted separately from the trout limit.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 5 black bass per day — statewide default for California lakes and reservoirs. Smallmouth bass presence at Donner Lake is reported by fishing-data sites but not directly confirmed via a CDFW stocking/survey page — treat species presence as medium confidence.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: 12-inch total-length minimum for black bass — statewide default for lakes and reservoirs.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
candidates.summary: Anglers 16 and older must carry a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.requires_permit_note: A valid second-rod stamp is required to fish with a second rod.

candidates.summary: No bait or lure restrictions. Anglers may fish with up to 2 rods at once if they hold a valid second-rod stamp.
